tools.name: list_investments
tools.title: Investments
tools.description: Every investment service (broker, exchange, manual account) with its value in its own `currency` and in the display currency, net invested, gain, simple return and XIRR, plus the portfolio's totals in the display `currency`, as GET /api/v1/investments. Returns are ratios (0.05 = 5 %). Gain and returns are null unless the service's history is complete (`reliable`; `reliableFrom` says from when it is); `xirrStatus` says why XIRR is missing. The portfolio leaves out transfers between its own services and includes the exchange effect. `pnl` is the profit and loss of the period (the year running by default), the number the screen shows: realized, unrealized (open positions only), income, fees, corrections and exchange effect add up to it, and the services add up to the portfolio with `transfers`.

period.description: A year (YYYY) or `all`; default the year running.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD; with `to`, wins over `period`.

tools.name: get_investment_holdings
tools.title: Investment holdings
tools.description: The open positions of one investment service today — asset, product, quantity, price, value and gain in the service's `currency` — as GET /api/v1/investments/{accountId}/holdings. Take the account id from list_investments.

tools.name: get_investment
tools.title: Investment service
tools.description: One investment service by account id (from list_investments) in a period (default: the year running; `period` = all, a year, or custom with `from` and `to`): its value today, its profit and loss of the period in its own and in the display currency with the parts that add up to it and the Modified Dietz return, what each position added, and its latest events. Amounts are decimal strings, returns are ratios.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.title: Preferences
tools.description: The user's preferences, as GET /api/v1/preferences: time zone, language, number format, display currency, first day of the week, theme, and the working day of Time off.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Profile
tools.description: The user's name, email and role, as GET /api/v1/profile.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: Categories
tools.description: The user's categories as GET /api/v1/categories: groups and sub-categories in tree order, the macro each counts in (income, expense, transfer) and how many movements use it.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: Labels
tools.description: The user's labels as GET /api/v1/labels, with how many movements carry each.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.title: Connections
tools.description: The user's connections to banks and services as GET /api/v1/connections: state, last good reading, next reading, and the last runs.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.title: Accounts
tools.description: Every account with its type, currency, state and today's balance, as GET /api/v1/accounts.

tools.name: get_account_balances
tools.title: Balance history
tools.description: The recorded balances of one account, newest first, as GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/balances. Take the account id from list_accounts.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.title: Summary
tools.description: Net worth, liquid cash, and this month's income, spending and net, as GET /api/v1/summary. `currency` is the user's display currency, which netWorth, previousNetWorth and cash are converted to at the ECB rate of their day. `netWorthPartial`/`cashPartial` are true when an account counted has no balance yet, or no exchange rate to that currency. `excludedCount`, when present, is how many movements in another currency income, spending and net left out for want of a rate.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.title: Transactions
tools.description: Movements filtered by period, account, category, type and payee text, with the totals of the whole filtered range (not just the page), as GET /api/v1/transactions. Paginate with offset.

category_id.description: Only this category (a group includes its sub-categories).

tools.name: get_spending
tools.title: Spending
tools.description: The movements of a range summed by category (with each one's share), by category and type, by day or by month, as GET /api/v1/transactions/spending. Takes the filters of list_transactions.

tools.name: list_budgets
tools.title: Budgets
tools.description: The budgets of one month with their limit, what was spent and the status, plus the totals and the spending no budget covers, as the Budgets page shows them.

month.description: YYYY-MM; the current month when omitted.

tools.name: list_pockets
tools.title: Pockets
tools.description: The open pockets with what is left in each, their target and monthly amount, and the totals of the Pockets page: earmarked, the backing accounts' balance and what is free on them.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.title: Subscriptions
tools.description: The subscriptions with their price, cycle, next charge and the payment check of the period under way, the monthly and yearly totals, the payment alerts and what they commit on each paying account.

tools.name: list_interest_rules
tools.title: Interest rules
tools.description: The interest rules on the accounts: rate bands, tax, day basis, settlement, what each accrued since 1 January, net and gross, and the next payout.

tools.name: get_interest_rule
tools.title: Interest rule
tools.description: One interest rule with its settlements, each reconciled with what the bank paid, its posting to the source and its latest days of accrual.

tools.name: get_time_off
tools.title: Time off
tools.description: One year of leave: what is left of vacation and ROL (and whether the payslip or the allowance says so), days taken and planned by month and kind, the forecast at year end, overdrawn kinds and months a payslip counted more leave than recorded. Lengths in minutes; minutesPerDay is a day.

tools.name: get_payroll
tools.title: Payroll
tools.description: Every payslip applied or waiting for a decision, by year: gross, taxes, social, net and the other amounts, the leave left in hours, the year's totals and means; the mean net of the last 3, 6 and 12 months, the tax rate and the yearly gross (RAL). Amounts are decimal strings.

tools.name: get_payslip
tools.title: Payslip
tools.description: One payslip by its document id (from get_payroll): its values with origin and verification, the checks that passed or failed, the warnings, the leave taken by month and the body lines.

tools.name: get_funds
tools.title: Funds
tools.description: Every pension fund in a period (default: the year running; `period` = all, a year, or custom with `from` and `to`): what the portfolio gained net of what went in, the return, the fees, the money paid in by origin (you, employer, TFR), and each fund's own figures. Amounts are decimal strings, returns are fractions.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.title: Fund
tools.description: One pension fund by id (from get_funds) in a period: value, gain, return, fees, money paid in by origin, and the projection at the hypothesis rates.
